C.0.1 q=(0,0)\textbf{q}=(0,0) scattering processes analysis

In the limit of q⋅Ri≪1\textbf{q}\cdot\textbf{R}_{i}\ll 1 and to first order in crystal momenta, The hamiltonian describing q=(0,0)\textbf{q}=(0,0) scattering processes is:

H⁡(t,A0)|(0,0)\displaystyle H(t,A^{0})|_{(0,0)} ≃2​|R1|​∑q,p∈BZt∗​[qx​δp0−Ax0​(p)]​(fa†​((π,0)+q)​fb​((π,0)+q+p)+fa†​((0,π)+q)​fb​((0,π)+q+p))\displaystyle\simeq\sqrt{2}|\textbf{R}_{1}|\sum_{\textbf{q},\textbf{p}\in\text{BZ}}t^{*}\big[\textbf{q}_{x}\delta_{\textbf{p}\textbf{0}}-A^{0}_{x}(\textbf{p})\big]\bigg(f^{{\dagger}}_{a}((\pi,0)+\textbf{q})f_{b}((\pi,0)+\textbf{q}+\textbf{p})+f^{{\dagger}}_{a}((0,\pi)+\textbf{q})f_{b}((0,\pi)+\textbf{q}+\textbf{p})\bigg)
+i​t​[qy​δp0−Ay0​(p)]​(fa†​((0,π)+q)​fb​((0,π)+q+p)−fa†​((π,0)+q)​fb​((π,0)+q+p))+h.c.\displaystyle+it\big[\textbf{q}_{y}\delta_{\textbf{p}\textbf{0}}-A^{0}_{y}(\textbf{p})\big]\bigg(f^{{\dagger}}_{a}((0,\pi)+\textbf{q})f_{b}((0,\pi)+\textbf{q}+\textbf{p})-f^{{\dagger}}_{a}((\pi,0)+\textbf{q})f_{b}((\pi,0)+\textbf{q}+\textbf{p})\bigg)+h.c.

where:

Ax0​(p)\displaystyle A^{0}_{x}(\textbf{p}) ≐A10​(p)+A30​(p)2​|R1|\displaystyle\doteq\frac{A^{0}_{1}(\textbf{p})+A^{0}_{3}(\textbf{p})}{\sqrt{2}|\textbf{R}_{1}|}
Ay0​(p)\displaystyle A^{0}_{y}(\textbf{p}) ≐A20​(p)+A40​(p)2​|R1|\displaystyle\doteq\frac{A^{0}_{2}(\textbf{p})+A^{0}_{4}(\textbf{p})}{\sqrt{2}|\textbf{R}_{1}|}

Thus:

H⁡(t,A0)|(0,0)\displaystyle H(t,A^{0})|_{(0,0)} =∑q,p∈BZv​{Ψ†​(𝒒)​[(qx​δp0−Ax0​(p))​𝟙⊗τx+(qy​δp0−Ay0​(p))​ρz⊗τy]​Ψ​(𝒒+𝒑)​t∈ℝΨ†​(𝒒)​[(qx​δp0−Ax0​(p))​𝟙⊗τy+(qy​δp0−Ay0​(p))​ρz⊗τx]​Ψ​(𝒒+𝒑)​t∈i​ℝ\displaystyle=\sum_{\textbf{q},\textbf{p}\in\text{BZ}}v\begin{cases}\Psi^{{\dagger}}(\bm{q})\bigg[\big(\textbf{q}_{x}\delta_{\textbf{p}\textbf{0}}-A^{0}_{x}(\textbf{p})\big)\mathbb{1}\otimes\tau^{x}+\big(\textbf{q}_{y}\delta_{\textbf{p}\textbf{0}}-A^{0}_{y}(\textbf{p})\big)\rho^{z}\otimes\tau^{y}\bigg]\Psi(\bm{q}+\bm{p})\,\,\,\,\,t\in\mathbb{R}\\ \Psi^{{\dagger}}(\bm{q})\bigg[\big(\textbf{q}_{x}\delta_{\textbf{p}\textbf{0}}-A^{0}_{x}(\textbf{p})\big)\mathbb{1}\otimes\tau^{y}+\big(\textbf{q}_{y}\delta_{\textbf{p}\textbf{0}}-A^{0}_{y}(\textbf{p})\big)\rho^{z}\otimes\tau^{x}\bigg]\Psi(\bm{q}+\bm{p})\,\,\,\,\,t\in i\mathbb{R}\\ \end{cases}

where v≐2​|t|​|𝐑1|v\doteq\sqrt{2}|t||{\bf R}_{1}| and the sets of τi\tau^{i} and ρj\rho^{j} Pauli matrices are understood to act respectively on {a,b}\{a,b\}  sub-lattice spaces and on {(π,0),(0,π)}\{(\pi,0),(0,\pi)\} valley space.

C.0.2 q=(π,π)\textbf{q}=(\pi,\pi) momentum scattering processes

To first order in crystal momenta, The hamiltonian describing q=(π,π)\textbf{q}=(\pi,\pi) scattering processes is:

H⁡(t,Aπ)|(π,π)\displaystyle H(t,A^{\pi})|_{(\pi,\pi)} ≃2​|R1|​∑q,p∈BZ(−t∗​Bxπ​(p)+i​t​Byπ​(p))​fa†​((π,0)+q)​fb​((0,π)+q+p)\displaystyle\simeq\sqrt{2}|\textbf{R}_{1}|\sum_{\textbf{q},\textbf{p}\in\text{BZ}}\big(-t^{*}B^{\pi}_{x}(\textbf{p})+itB^{\pi}_{y}(\textbf{p})\big)f^{{\dagger}}_{a}((\pi,0)+\textbf{q})f_{b}((0,\pi)+\textbf{q}+\textbf{p})
−(t∗​Bxπ​(p)+i​t​Byπ​(p))​fa†​((0,π)+q)​fb​((π,0)+q+p)+h.c.\displaystyle-\big(t^{*}B^{\pi}_{x}(\textbf{p})+itB^{\pi}_{y}(\textbf{p})\big)f^{{\dagger}}_{a}((0,\pi)+\textbf{q})f_{b}((\pi,0)+\textbf{q}+\textbf{p})+h.c.

where:

Bxπ​(x)\displaystyle B^{\pi}_{x}(\textbf{x}) =A3π​(x)−A1π​(x)2​|R1|,\displaystyle=\frac{A^{\pi}_{3}(\textbf{x})-A^{\pi}_{1}(\textbf{x})}{\sqrt{2}|\textbf{R}_{1}|}, (S-4)
Byπ​(x)\displaystyle B^{\pi}_{y}(\textbf{x}) =A4π​(x)−A2π​(x)2​|R1|.\displaystyle=\frac{A^{\pi}_{4}(\textbf{x})-A^{\pi}_{2}(\textbf{x})}{\sqrt{2}|\textbf{R}_{1}|}.

In the limit of q⋅Ri≪1\textbf{q}\cdot\textbf{R}_{i}\ll 1, and following a similar procedure as before we can write the hamiltonian above in a matrix form:

H(t,Aπ)|(π,π)=−v∑q,p∈BZ{Ψ†​(𝒒)​ρx⊗[Bxπ​(p)​τx+Byπ​(p)​τy]​Ψ​(𝒒+𝒑)​t∈ℝΨ†​(𝒒)​ρy⊗[Bxπ​(p)​τx−Byπ​(p)​τy]​Ψ​(𝒒+𝒑)​t∈i​ℝH(t,A^{\pi})|_{(\pi,\pi)}=-v\sum_{\textbf{q},\textbf{p}\in\text{BZ}}\begin{cases}\Psi^{{\dagger}}(\bm{q})\rho^{x}\otimes\bigg[B^{\pi}_{x}(\textbf{p})\tau^{x}+B^{\pi}_{y}(\textbf{p})\tau^{y}\bigg]\Psi(\bm{q}+\bm{p})\,\,\,\,t\in\mathbb{R}\\ \Psi^{{\dagger}}(\bm{q})\rho^{y}\otimes\bigg[B^{\pi}_{x}(\textbf{p})\tau^{x}-B^{\pi}_{y}(\textbf{p})\tau^{y}\bigg]\Psi(\bm{q}+\bm{p})\,\,\,\,t\in i\mathbb{R}\\ \end{cases}
